name: docs-vault
description: Skills for keeping a project's docs/ folder as an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: docs-vault
plugins.description: Six skills for a project's docs/ Obsidian vault: init bootstraps it, recall reads it, record writes it, todos lists the open work, graph colour-codes the graph view, and preset saves and applies your Obsidian settings. The vault keeps a dated, append-only journal with #decision and #todo tags, and leaves everything else to the project's Conventions.md.
